content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Physical Director Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) for filling temporary positions at their agricultural polytechnic and research stations in Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The organization is hiring candidates specifically for the Physical Director (Part Time) position on a contractual basis to manage physical education activities.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Physical Director (Part Time) post during this recruitment drive at Maruteru.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Candidates do not need to send any online or offline advance applications; they can directly attend the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 13 October 2026 at 10:30 AM at the specified venue in West Godavari District.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Bachelor Degree in Physical Education from a recognized UGC or AICTE university to be eligible for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for male and female candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is set at 40 years for male candidates and 45 years for female candidates as on the date of the scheduled interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed as Physical Director (Part Time) will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at RARS, Maruteru, located in the West Godavari District of Andhra Pradesh with the pincode 534122.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original certificates, mark sheets, testimonials, experience certificates, and one set of self-attested photocopies starting from matriculation onwards.
